description.value: Nat's New York Pizzeria is a beloved Kitsilano institution founded in 1992 by cousins Nat and Franco Bastone, who traveled to Yonkers, New York to learn 100-year-old family recipes for thin-crust, hand-tossed New York-style pizza rooted in their Calabrian heritage. Over 30 years in business, it has earned a reputation as a true neighbourhood gathering place, with walls lined with community photos and memorabilia, and a loyal following that includes celebrities like Ryan Reynolds and Joshua Jackson. A second location operates in Vancouver's West End on Denman Street.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at natspizza.com is fully accessible and confirms an active, long-running restaurant. The Kitsilano location address (2684 West Broadway, Vancouver, BC V6K 2G3) and phone (604-737-0707) are confirmed on the /about subpage and match the OSM coordinates (49.2639, -123.1659). The menu page explicitly labels multiple pizzas as 'Vegetarian' and lists 'The Vegan (no cheese)' option, confirming vegetarian/vegan availability. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, takeout labeling) are mentioned anywhere on the website.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant with over 30 years of operation confirmed by a fully functional website. A reliable food stop for touring cyclists passing through Kitsilano on West Broadway.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Kitsilano location phone is 604-737-0707; the West End (Denman Street) location is separately reachable at 604-642-0777 and may warrant its own directory entry if an OSM node exists for it.
